verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events collects behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems. Official SDKs cover browser, iOS, Android, Node.js and other platforms, plus an HTTP Tracking API with a batch endpoint. The docs define five event types: identify, track, page, screen, and group. missing for 10: detailed per-call tracking-spec field schemas in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.
